title: A weak or none pack offers kb_feedback on servers without the tool, the kb: hook drops the feedback: line, and tools.md says every check: line sets a route
goal: The feedback: hint line prints only where kb_feedback is served, so a kb_http.py or --roots server, which does not list the tool, prints no hint; token-efficiency.md says which servers print it; the kb: hook's web-route context keeps the feedback: line of a weak or none pack beside HEAD_LINES and the pack: line (kb_hook.routed), as tools.md says; tools.md's route-lines passage names the check: lines that set route: split and the scatter note as the one that sets none; and the extended test_redact.py test asserts the limited server's pack and the hook's none pack

run: import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon,kb_mcp,kb_hook;q='zzqx frobnicate the quux widget lattice';hook=json.dumps(kb_hook.respond('kb: '+q)[0]);kbcommon.serve_only(['public']);r=kb_mcp.handle({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'kb_pack','arguments':{'question':q}}})['result']['content'][0]['text'];bad=[n for n,v in (('hook web route keeps feedback line','feedback: kb_feedback' in hook),('limited server prints no hint','feedback: kb_feedback' not in r)) if not v];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
import sys;t=open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(1 if 'pack with a '+chr(96)+'check:'+chr(96)+' line or a word held nowhere' in t else 0)

import sys,re;t=open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=[x for x in re.split(r'(?<=[.;])\s+',t) if 'feedback:'+chr(96)+' line' in x];print(s[:1]);sys.exit(0 if s and all(('--roots' in x or 'kb_http' in x or 'served' in x) for x in s) else 1)
